definitions.explanation: Making arrangements or preparations for something, especially booking or organizing.
An official order to search for and apprehend a suspect.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{手配|てはい}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{警察|けいさつ}が{犯人|はんにん}を{手配|てはい}した。
examples.english: The police put out a search for the criminal.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{手配|てはい}は{済|す}んでいます。
examples.english: The arrangements for the meeting are complete.

notes:
USAGE:
・{手配|てはい}する - to arrange, to put out a search
・{手配|てはい}を{整|ととの}える - to make arrangements

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{全国|ぜんこく}{手配|てはい} - nationwide search (police)
・{指名|しめい}{手配|てはい} - wanted notice (with name)
・{手配|てはい}{済|ず}み - arrangement completed
・{旅行|りょこう}の{手配|てはい} - travel arrangements
・{車|くるま}の{手配|てはい} - arranging transportation

BUSINESS USAGE:
In business contexts, {手配|てはい} often refers to organizing logistics, booking, or procurement.

RELATED:
・{手続|てつづ}き - procedures, formalities
・{予約|よやく} - reservation
・{準備|じゅんび} - preparation
